where: The Ashfall Shelf (cinderwind_ashfall): the main-path route between Cinderwind Scarp and Galehigh — a high grey shelf of century-old slag tips, ash-grass in the wind, the haulers' camp brazier, the old kiln stack on the cliff
mood: Daylight after three caves: wide, windswept and a little melancholy, warmed by a brazier; grey ash-grass, coal-smoke and open sky, the climb nearly done.
